title: Direct Response Copywriter / Creative Strategist
description:
DIRECT RESPONSE COPYWRITER / CREATIVE STRATEGIST

Blackboard · Remote (Philippines) · Full-time

AUD $48,000 per year (approx. ₱180,000 per month) + performance bonuses



We're looking for an expert direct response copywriter who can write UGC scripts for paid social at volume, and use ad data to d
 what gets written next.



------------------------------------------------------------



ABOUT BLACKBOARD



Blackboard is a creative and paid social agency in Richmond, Melbourne. We work with DTC brands across supplements, health, beverage and consumer goods, and we do everything in-house, from strategy and scripts through to casting, shooting, editing and running the media. The work ranges from full production days with a crew to a creator filming a street interview on their phone, and all of it is built to sell on Meta.



We're small and growing quickly. The people joining now will be running the teams in a couple of years.



------------------------------------------------------------



THE ROLE, AND WHERE YOU'D SIT



This is a fully remote role, working with our team in Melbourne. You'd own the creative strategy across our accounts. You'd be reading what's working in the ad accounts, d
 what gets made next, writing the scripts and the creator direction, and then checking what comes back against what you intended.



Your main job is scriptwriting, at around 50-100+ scripts a month, plus the hooks, ad copy and creator direction that go with them. That volume means you need to be fast without the quality dropping off, and you need frameworks rather than inspiration to get there.



You'd work most closely with our talent manager, who casts and briefs every creator, and with our post-production team. You'd also be on client calls monthly, walking them through performance and pitching the next round of ideas.



Because you're remote, communication matters more than it would in an office. Almost everything happens over Slack,
, Loom and video calls. You need to write clearly, explain your thinking without being asked twice, flag problems early, and keep the team updated without anyone chasing you. If your work only makes sense once you've explained it on a call, this isn't the right role.



------------------------------------------------------------



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Creative strategy and data



- Review creative performance across accounts and identify what's scaling, what's fatiguing and what's worth iterating on

- Build the testing roadmap for each client: the angles, the formats, the messaging territories, what we try next depending on the result

- Run deep competitor and category research through the Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, landing pages and customer reviews

- Take competitor ads apart: which audience it's for, which objection it handles, where in the funnel it sits



Scripting



- Write direct response scripts for Meta and TikTok across every format we shoot: UGC, founder explainers, podcast-style formats, street interviews, demos, testimonials, animated ads, vlogs etc.

- Structure scripts around market awareness level and match the angle to where the customer actually is in the funnel

- Own the hooks and CTAs, and be able to justify every line in a script

- Turn winning scripts into iteration sets: new hooks, new openers, new CTAs on a proven body

- Write UGC that sounds like the way people actually talk



Working with the team



- Write creator direction specific enough that nobody needs a follow-up call: what they say, how they say it, what they're doing on camera, what's in frame when they film

- Hand scripts and direction to our talent manager, who takes it from there with the creators

- Review edits from post against the original strategy and catch it when a cut has lost the angle

- Be the creative lead across talent and post so the finished ad matches what was planned

- Contribute to our scripting standards and review frameworks as the team grows

- Work overlapping hours with Melbourne (AEST) so you're available when the team and clients are



Clients



- Monthly deep dives with clients on what ran, what happened and what's next

- Communicate creative strategy in plain language

- Turn client feedback into sharper briefs rather than just revisions



------------------------------------------------------------



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- 5+ years in direct response copywriting, creative strategy or performance creative, in an agency or a brand spending real money

- Hands-on experience with paid ads. Not adjacent to it. You've worked inside accounts with budget behind them

- Real direct response scripts that ran as paid media, and the ability to explain the strategy behind them: who it was for, what awareness level, what objection it handled, what the numbers did

- Proven ability to write at volume across multiple brands without the standard slipping

- A solid grasp of direct response fundamentals: market awareness levels, funnel stages, offers, objections and proof

- A real understanding of the psychology behind why an ad works

- Able to navigate Meta Ads Manager and read creative-level performance without help

- Active enough on TikTok and Instagram to spot a format early

- Excellent written English. Your copy goes straight to clients and creators, and most of your communication with us is written

- Strong at working remotely: clear updates, fast responses during working hours, and comfortable on video calls with clients

- Organised across multiple brands and multiple scripts in flight

- Reliable internet and a quiet setup for client calls

- Based in the Philippines



------------------------------------------------------------



NICE TO HAVE



- Agency background

- DTC / eCommerce experience

- TikTok Ads Manager

- Experience directing creators or working on shoots

- Comfortable filming or editing your own low-fi content

- AI tools already in your workflow. We build our own internal software with AI and it's a real part of how we work, so there's room here for someone interested in it

- Have built or documented a testing framework before



------------------------------------------------------------



WHAT'S ON OFFER



- AUD $48,000 per year, paid monthly in AUD (approx. ₱180,000 per month at current rates)

- Performance bonuses

- Fully remote

- Ownership of the creative standard across the agency, growing into leading the creative team as we hire

- We've built our own reporting, so you'll see exactly how every script you write performed



------------------------------------------------------------



HOW TO APPLY



We're hiring one person, and we'll hire the one who proves they can make our ads perform better. So this isn't a resume-and-cover-letter application. Show us your work and your thinking.



 me directly with:



1. Two or three direct response scripts you wrote that ran as paid ads. For each one, tell us the strategy behind it: who it was for, what awareness level you wrote it for, what angle or objection you were working, and what happened when it ran. Numbers if you have them.



2. Your understanding of Meta Ads Manager. How you read creative-level performance, what you look at, and how you d
 what gets written next.



3. Your tools and process. Any frameworks, testing systems, AI tools or internal processes you've built or use to write at volume. Show us, don't just list them.



4. One ad you've seen recently that you think is excellent, and why.



5. What you'd bring that we don't have. What skill, system or way of working would make our agency better the month you start.



6.
 must be titled "Blackboard Agency Application - Direct Response Copywriter [insert name] - all others will not be reviewed



No cover letter needed. We'll read every application and reply to the ones that show real work.

Instead, you will be responsible for following established procedures, monitoring accounts and credit-repair activity, keeping records organized, identifying changes or problems, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



What We Are Looking For

* Knows when to solve a problem independently and when to ask for help

* Has excellent written and spoken English



Responsibilities



Your responsibilities may include:



* Monitoring client accounts and credit-repair activity on a daily basis

* Tracking the status of accounts and disputes

* Following our established credit-repair procedures

* Updating spreadsheets, records, and internal systems

* Keeping detailed notes and documentation

* Organizing client files and documents

* Performing online research when necessary

* Learning our systems and procedures quickly

* Making sure daily tasks are completed without constant supervision

* Reporting important issues or changes to management



The Type of Person We Want



We are not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions.

We want someone who can be given a task or procedure, understand it, and then take ownership of getting it done.



For example, if you notice that something is missing, a status has changed, or something does not look right, we want you to notice it and bring it to our attention rather than waiting for someone to discover it.



You should be the type of person who thinks:



“What needs to be done next?”



rather than:



“What should I do now?”



Important Qualifications Required:

Credit Repair Experience



Previous experience in credit repair, credit reports, dispute processing, financial services, or administrative operations is a plus, but it is not required.



We are willing to train the right person.



What matters most to us is your ability to learn, think, pay attention to details, follow procedures, and take initiative.



How We Hire



We are looking for a long-term team member, not someone who is simply looking for a temporary job.

If you are a smart, dependable, proactive person who learns quickly and takes pride in getting things done correctly, we would like to hear from you.

title: GOHIGHLEVEL ADMIN / OPERATIONS SPECIALIST
description:
GOHIGHLEVEL ADMIN / OPERATIONS SPECIALIST

Remote | Philippines-Based | Full-Time | Includes Paid Certification Training



Approx. PHP 64,000 - 96,000/month full-time ($6.00 - $9.00 USD/hour, paid in USD; PHP amount varies with exchange rate)



A client's automation breaks at 2am and no leads are getting routed. Can you find the failure point, fix it, and make sure it never happens again? Do you think in triggers, conditions, and edge cases -- not just clicks? If you're the person other people come to when the system stops working, keep reading.



We're hiring a GoHighLevel Admin / Operations Specialist on behalf of a U.S.-based marketing agency serving home service and remodeling brands. You'll be the person who builds, maintains, and troubleshoots the GoHighLevel infrastructure that our clients' businesses run on -- pipelines, workflows, automations, integrations, and reporting.



This is an operations role, not a marketing role. Your job is to make the machine run correctly, every day, for every client. When it works, nobody notices. That's the goal.



YOUR FIRST WEEK: PAID CERTIFICATION TRAINING



Every specialist we place starts with one full week (Monday-Friday) of advanced, paid GoHighLevel training, ending in a certification exam.



You'll be trained on our standards for workflow architecture, snapshot deployment, integrations, and troubleshooting -- then tested on them. Passing the certification is required to move into the full-time role. We invest in this because we hold our specialists to a higher standard than a typical GHL admin, and we'd rather train you properly than hand you a login and hope for the best.



If you already hold a GoHighLevel certification or have deep platform experience, tell us -- it factors into where you land in the pay range.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Build & Automate:

- Build and maintain advanced GoHighLevel workflows, triggers, and automations across multiple client sub-accounts

- Set up and manage pipelines, opportunity stages, custom fields, custom values, and tags

- Build and deploy snapshots, funnels, forms, surveys, and calendars

- Configure integrations and connections (webhooks, Zapier/Make, third-party tools, tracking and conversion events)



Operate & Troubleshoot:

- Monitor automations daily and catch failures before the client does

- Diagnose broken workflows, missed triggers, routing errors, and data issues -- then document the fix

- Manage A2P 10DLC registration, domain and
 setup, phone number provisioning, and deliverability basics

- Maintain data hygiene: duplicates, tagging standards, contact records, and reporting accuracy



Systems & Documentation:

- Write and maintain SOPs so every build is repeatable, not dependent on memory

- Standardize account structure so any team member can pick up an account and understand it

- Build dashboards and reporting views that give the team and clients clear visibility

- Onboard new client accounts from a blank sub-account to fully operational



Collaboration:

- Work alongside media buyers, copywriters, and video editors -- you're the operational backbone that connects their work to the client's CRM

- Translate what the team needs into a system that delivers it

- Flag issues early and bring solutions, not just problems



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- 2+ years of hands-on experience administering GoHighLevel (or a comparable CRM/automation platform such as HubSpot, Keap, or ActiveCampaign, with proven GHL ability)

- Genuine workflow-level thinking: you can map a multi-step automation with branching conditions, wait steps, and failure paths -- and explain WHY you built it that way

- Strong troubleshooting instincts and the patience to trace a problem to its actual root cause

- Comfort managing multiple client sub-accounts without dropping details

- Working knowledge of integrations: webhooks, APIs, Zapier or Make

- Clear written English -- much of this role is documentation and async communication

- Organized, methodical, and proactive -- you notice what's broken before you're told

- Reliable home office setup with stable, high-speed internet

- Availability to work Monday-Friday with at least 4 hours of overlap with U.S. Pacific business hours (9am-5pm PT). The mandatory training week is scheduled during U.S. business hours.



When you apply, include the word BLUEPRINT in the "Anything else you'd like us to know?" field of the application form. This is how we know you read the full post.



NICE TO HAVE



- Existing GoHighLevel certification

- Agency-side experience managing GHL for multiple clients

- Experience with home services, construction, remodeling, or local lead generation

- Basic HTML/CSS or custom code snippets in funnels

- Experience with A2P 10DLC,
 authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), or deliverability troubleshooting

- Experience writing SOPs or training other admins



WHAT'S INCLUDED



- $6.00 - $9.00 USD/hour, paid in USD (approx. PHP 64,000 - 96,000/month full-time) -- placement in the range depends on experience, prior certification, and demonstrated skill

- One week of paid advanced GoHighLevel training and certification, provided by us

- After 90 days: performance bonuses tied to account health and client retention kick in

- After 90 days: HMO coverage on your terms -- choose the HMO plan that fits you (and your family), and we cover it through a monthly healthcare benefit. You pick the provider; we pay for it.

- Fully remote, full-time position

- Clear growth path into a Senior Operations Specialist role as the team scales

- Work with a fast-moving U.S.-based team in the home service industry



HOW TO APPLY



The ONLY way to apply is through our official application portal:







Applications sent as OnlineJobs.ph messages will NOT be reviewed. The link goes to our standard applicant portal -- it takes about 5-10 minutes. We never charge fees at any stage of hiring, ever.



In the application, you'll be asked to walk us through one advanced workflow or automation you built: what problem it solved, how you structured the triggers and conditions, what edge cases you accounted for, and what broke along the way. Be specific -- this is the single most important part of your application, and vague answers will not advance.



We read every qualified application personally.



This position is placed through RevStone, a managed staffing company supporting U.S.-based businesses. RevStone handles your onboarding, payroll, HR, and benefits -- so you can focus on the work.

title: Guest Experience Specialist, Third Coast Elevated Stays
description:
Third Coast Elevated Stays is a locally rooted, family-owned property management company serving the Texas coast markets of Galveston, Corpus Christi, Rockport, Port Aransas, and South Padre Island. We are focused on providing elevated stays for our guests and elevated stewardship for our homeowners. Our goal is to grow in a way that celebrates what makes the Texas coast special - its people, coastal culture, beach communities, and local character - while delivering elevated experiences for guests and thoughtful, reliable stewardship for homeowners.



Tech stack (daily tools): Guesty (PMS + guest inbox), Breezeway (tasks/workorders + cleaning), RingCentral (calls/SMS).



Our Elevated Promises

Everything we do is guided by our Elevated Promises. They are our operating standard and the way we earn five-star stays and trusted, long-term homeowner partnerships.



1. Elevated Guest Engagement: Proactive, elevated hospitality from booking to five-star review. 

We believe vacations are special—something people save for, plan for, and look forward to. Our job is to make every stay feel seamless and memorable. We anticipate needs, communicate early, check in during the stay, and resolve issues quickly with warmth and care. Our guest journey is intentionally crafted to deliver the kind of responsiveness, thoughtfulness, and attention to detail that turns great trips into truly elevated experiences.



2. Elevated Home Stewardship: We care for every home as if it were our own.

As homeowners in these markets, we know what true home stewardship looks like. We operate with a proactive mindset of quality, consistency, and pride. Weekly home checks, rigorous cleaning standards, quality control, seasonal readiness, and preventive maintenance are all part of how we ensure every property is clean, protected, and presentation ready, for guests and for you. We treat every home with the same respect and diligence we expect for our own.



3. Elevated Homeowner Partnerships: We treat each home like our own investment.

Every homeowner has different goals – maximizing revenue, balancing personal use, focusing on long-term appreciation, or simply enjoying peace of mind. Our role is to be a true partner in those goals, not simply a property manager. As owners and operators in this region ourselves, our guidance comes from real-world results, not theory. Through regular business reviews, thoughtful design and amenity recommendations, revenue and pricing insights, and brand-building support, we help each property reach its highest potential.



Our Guest Experience team is one of the biggest ways we deliver these promises. This is hospitality work. You are a core part of our team, not an outsourced call-center function.?



Job Description: Guest Experience Specialist - Texas Coast

As a Guest Experience Specialist, you own guest communication and coordination. You are the voice of Third Coast, a core part of our team, and a key driver of five-star stays. You will manage guest messaging and calls, coordinate workorders and cleaning schedules with our local teams and vendors, and bring elevated hospitality and experiences to every stay.



You will own:

• Proactive outreach and warm guest engagement that drives five-star stays

• Guest messaging and phone communication

• Workorder coordination and task follow-through

• Cleaning scheduling and day-to-day coordination with our local team and vendors



Working Hours

We provide live coverage from 7:00am to 11:00pm Central Time (CDT). You will be assigned a consistent shift. On-call after-hour coverage (11:00pm-7:00am CDT) is handled by a separate rotation.



Central Daylight Time (CDT) ? Philippines Time (PHT):

• 7am–3pm CDT ? 8pm–4am PHT

• 11am–7pm CDT ? 12am–8am PHT

• 3pm–11pm CDT ? 4am–12pm PHT

• 11pm–7am CDT ? 12pm–8pm PHT



Compensation and Incentives

• Base pay: $800 USD per month (full-time, based on experience)

• 13th month pay: offered in December (prorated for partial years)

• Monthly 5-Star Bonus: $50 if the monthly average rating is 4.85+ and the review rate is 60%+.

• PTO: Accrues at 1 paid days per month (usable after 90 days; no annual rollover)



Location

These roles are fully remote within the Philippines. 



Role and Responsibilities



Elevated Guest Engagement (Guesty + text/email)

• Answer guest messages (text,
, OTA inbox via Guesty) with warmth, clarity, and genuine care

• Proactively share helpful guidance (arrival, access, weather/roads, home-specific tips) and check in during the stay

• Keep conversations organized and ensure no guest is left waiting or confused

• Ensure every guest experience feels special and elevated



Welcome outreach (required for every reservation)

• Place a welcome phone call to every guest prior to arrival day and send a personalized welcome text

• Confirm access and comfort, offer help, and document any concerns quickly

• Identify opportunities to make the guest’s stay an elevated and memorable experience



Phone support (RingCentral)

• Answer calls quickly and calmly and return missed calls promptly

• Troubleshoot common issues (access, Wi-Fi, amenities, heating/hot tub basics) and escalate when needed



Workorders and coordination (Breezeway)

• Create workorders fast when issues arise and confirm vendor/team acknowledgment

• Track progress, follow up, and close the loop with guests and the local team

• Keep notes and task status clean so handoffs are seamless



Cleaning scheduling and turnovers (Breezeway)

• Coordinate turn cleaning schedules and special requests

• Ensure all turns are scheduled a minimum of one week prior to booking and confirm scheduled cleaner by 6:00pm CDT the night prior to a scheduled cleaning and communicate key notes to cleaners



Documentation and handoffs

• Maintain accurate property notes and updates

• Close out open items before shift end and hand off active issues with clear context



Monthly SLA Standards (required for bonus eligibility)

• Guest messages answered within 15 minutes during your shift (text,
, Guesty inbox)

• Phone calls answered within 30 seconds during your shift

About the Role



This is a part time position, 15 to 20 hours a week to start. You'll be responsible for importing credit reports, drafting dispute letters, and saving all documentation in Credit Repair Cloud. You'll also handle CFPB dispute drafting and track the progress of those disputes until they're resolved.

Minimum 1 year of hands on experience working in credit repair is required. You should already be comfortable working in Credit Repair Cloud, IdentityIQ, and SmartCredit, and you should know your way around the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau website for filing and tracking disputes.



You also need solid knowledge of the FCRA and consumer protection laws. We're not looking for someone who just fills in a template. We want someone who understands why a dispute works, what makes it legally sound, and how to write letters that actually get results.

title: Senior Bookkeeper
description:
The Role

Our Hawaii-based tax and bookkeeping firm is growing, and we need a senior bookkeeper who can do two things at once: keep their own portfolio of client books flawless, and raise the quality bar for the whole bookkeeping team. If you have spent years closing US clients’ books and you are the person others ask to double-check their work, this role was written for you.



About Us

Tax Resolution Services of Hawaii Inc is a tax and bookkeeping firm based in Hawaii, USA. We handle bookkeeping, month-end close, and tax filings for US small-business clients. Our team is small, stable, and quality-obsessed — clients trust us because their books are right and on time, every month. (Replace the bracketed firm name and adjust this blurb before posting.)



What Success Looks Like

Twelve months in, you own a portfolio of client books that close accurately and on schedule every single month, the daily and weekly review layer you run has caught errors before clients ever see them, and every Hawaii General Excise Tax filing has gone out on time. You are the firm’s quality backstop.



What You’ll Do

• Own full-cycle bookkeeping for multiple US-based clients in QuickBooks Online — daily transaction posting and categorization, bank and credit-card reconciliations, payroll reconciliation, Point of Sale reconciliation (Square, Toast, Stripe, etc.) and journal entries.

• Run month-end close in Double (formerly Keeper) — work close checklists, tie out balances, and deliver client-ready financials on schedule.

• Prepare and file Hawaii General Excise Tax returns (Forms G-45 and G-49). GET experience is a plus — we will train the Hawaii specifics.

• Own the close calendar — make sure every client’s books are closed timely and accurately each month, and escalate blockers early instead of late.

• Improve our playbook — tighten checklists and processes so quality doesn’t depend on heroics.



Requirements

• 10+ years of full-cycle bookkeeping for US-based businesses or US accounting/bookkeeping firms.

• Advanced QuickBooks Online skills — you can untangle a messy file, not just maintain a clean one.

• A track record of owning month-end close across multiple clients at the same time.

• Excellent written English — you will write review notes and client-facing summaries.

• Experience working with Double/Keeper

• Willingness to complete a practical skills test (bank rec, journal entries, POS Reconciliation, close, and an error-spotting review exercise). We test every finalist — a proven track record matters here.



Nice to Have

• QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification, an accounting degree, or CPA.

• Familiarity with Hawaii General Excise Tax or other US state sales/gross-receipts taxes.



Pay & Benefits

• USD $800 - $1200/month depending on experience — paid reliably, on time, twice a month.

• 13th-month pay.

• Long-term, stable role with a growth path to Bookkeeping Supervisor as the team grows.

• Daytime-friendly schedule — your PH morning overlaps our Hawaii afternoon, so no night shift. 



How to Apply

Start your application with the word RECONCILED so we know you read this far. Then answer these four questions (short answers are fine):

1. How many years have you done bookkeeping for US-based clients, and in which industries?

2. How many sets of client books do you currently close each month?

3. Describe one real error you caught while reviewing someone else’s work — what was it and how did you catch it?

4. What monthly salary are you looking for?



Applications that skip the code word or the questions will not be considered.

title: Executive Operations Assistant
description:
About the Business

We are a Florida-focused curative title real estate investing company. We work on properties with complicated ownership, probate, heirship, tax, lien, and title issues. Our business depends on clean follow-through, accurate documents, organized files, consistent communication, and disciplined execution from signed purchase agreement through attorney handoff, probate progress, document completion, and closing readiness.



Role Overview

This is not a generic virtual assistant role. We are looking for a calm, steady, detail-driven Executive Operations Assistant who can become the operational control point for the COO. The right person will keep the COO organized, coordinate transaction and notary workflows, monitor probate case progress, maintain complete deal files, and audit documents before key handoffs.



You should enjoy structure, checklists, clean folders, accurate notes, careful follow-up, and quiet execution. You do not need to be loud, salesy, or highly social. You do need to be reliable, precise, patient, consistent, and comfortable holding people accountable to next steps.



Core Responsibilities

1. Executive Assistant to the COO

• Protect the COO’s time by organizing priorities, reminders, follow-ups, meetings, and action items.

• Prepare daily priority lists, meeting notes, agendas, and post-meeting task summaries.

• Monitor assigned inboxes, messages, calendars, documents, and task lists for urgent items and missed follow-ups.

• Turn verbal instructions into clear written tasks, checklists, and next actions.

• Maintain calm, professional communication while supporting a fast-moving operator.



2. Transaction / Notary / Closing Coordination

• Coordinate mobile notary appointments with sellers, heirs, and notaries after purchase agreements are signed.

• Prepare and organize signing packages, notary instructions, FedEx labels, tracking links, and scanback requirements.

• Track execution of Joinders, Quitclaim Deeds, Assignments of Interest, Affidavits of Heirs, copies of IDs, and related documents.

• Review scanbacks for completeness before forwarding packages to the proper internal tea
mber, probate attorney, or closing-related party.

• Maintain transaction status, next steps, blockers, and deadlines in the CRM/project management system.



3. Probate Case Coordination

• Monitor probate-related deal progress and maintain case status updates.

• Communicate with probate attorneys and internal tea
mbers to track what is pending, filed, missing, signed, recorded, or ready for next action.

• Maintain open-items lists for each probate file, including missing heirs, missing documents, pending attorney tasks, and court/status updates.

• Organize probate documents, attorney correspondence, family/heir notes, and supporting evidence in the correct folders.

• Escalate stalled cases before they become forgotten cases.



4. Deal File Management / Curative File Control

• Keep every deal file clean, complete, and easy to understand.

• Maintain digital folders, naming conventions, document checklists, title issue notes, heir charts, seller information, and transaction records.

• Ensure each file has a clear current status, next action, responsible person, and due date.

• Prepare clean handoff packages for attorneys, title companies, internal reviewers, or closing coordination.

• Prevent scattered information, duplicate documents, missing IDs, incorrect versions, and unclear file history.



5. Quality Control / Document Audit

• Audit documents before signing, after scanback, before attorney handoff, and before title/closing handoff.

• Check names, dates, signatures, notarizations, legal descriptions, attachments, IDs, missing pages, and consistency across documents.

• Flag issues clearly and early instead of assuming someone else will catch them.

• Maintain QC checklists and document audit logs.

• Help the team reduce costly errors, closing delays, and repeated requests to sellers or heirs.



The Person Who Will Thrive in This Role

• You are calm under pressure and do not need constant excitement to stay engaged.

• You naturally create order out of scattered information.

• You are comfortable with repetitive follow-up, checklists, and status tracking.

• You notice small details that other people miss.

• You are professional, direct, and respectful when following up with sellers, notaries, attorneys, and internal tea
mbers.

• You can manage up: if the COO misses a decision, deadline, or open item, you will respectfully bring it back to the front.

• You prefer accuracy over speed, but you can still move quickly when the process is clear.

• You are loyal, stable, consistent, and serious about long-term work.



This Role Is Probably Not a Fit If...

• You need a highly social, chatty, people-heavy role to feel energized.

• You dislike repetitive checklists, document review, file organization, or administrative follow-through.

• You prefer improvising over following a proven process.

• You get bored when the work requires precision, patience, and consistency.

• You avoid following up because you do not want to bother people.

• You are uncomfortable working behind the scenes in a support and coordination role.

• You want a sales, negotiation, or lead-generation role instead of an operations support role.



Required Skills and Experience

• Excellent written English and professional communication skills.

• Strong organization, task tracking, and file management ability.

• High attention to detail when reviewing names, documents, dates, IDs, signatures, and instructions.

• Comfortable using CRMs, Google Drive, Google Sheets,
, calendars, messaging tools, and project/task systems.

• Ability to work Central Time Zone hours consistently.

• Reliable internet connection and quiet work environment.

• Experience as an Executive Assistant, Transaction Coordinator, Legal Assistant, Real Estate VA, Probate Assistant, Title Assistant, or Operations Coordinator is preferred.

• Experience with U.S. real estate, probate, legal documents, notary coordination, or title-related work is a strong advantage, but trainability and accuracy matter most.



Tools You May Use

• Pipedrive or similar CRM

• Google Workspace: Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar

• Phone/messaging systems such as Quo, WhatsApp, or similar

• Project/task management tools

• FedEx label and tracking workflows

• Shared digital folders and document checklists



Success Metrics

• No unsigned, missing, or incomplete document packages sent forward without being flagged.

• Every active transaction has a current status, next step, owner, and due date.

• Notary appointments, FedEx labels, scanbacks, attorney handoffs, and follow-ups are tracked without gaps.

• Probate cases do not stall silently; blockers are identified and escalated.

• Deal files are clean, organized, and ready for review at any time.

• The COO has fewer dropped balls, fewer reminders to give, and more operational visibility.



First 30/60/90 Days - Timeframe & Expected Progress



First 30 Days

Learn the business model, tools, document types, folder structure, transaction workflow, and daily communication rhythm. Begin supporting COO priorities and tracking simple tasks.



First 60 Days

Own notary coordination, scanback tracking, deal file organization, and basic QC checklists with supervision. Begin maintaining probate status trackers and open-items lists.



First 90 Days

Operate as the daily control point for COO support, transaction coordination, probate tracking, file hygiene, and document audit workflows. Identify process gaps and help improve SOPs.



Schedule and Compensation

• $5/hour starting compensation plus deal bonuses.

• Central Time Zone working hours required.

• Long-term opportunity for someone who becomes dependable, accurate, and deeply trusted.

• Deal bonuses are tied to successful transaction progress and closed deals, based on internal company policy.



How to Apply

To apply, reply with the subject line: "Executive Operations Assistant - Detail Control" and include the following:

1. A short paragraph explaining why you are a strong fit for a detail-heavy operations support role.

2. Your experience with executive assistance, transaction coordination, real estate, legal documents, probate, title, notary coordination, or file management.

3. A specific example of a time you caught a small detail that prevented a bigger problem.

4. A specific example of how you track multiple open tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups.

5. Your availability in Central Time Zone hours.

6. Your internet speed, computer setup, and whether you have a quiet work environment.

7. Confirm that you are comfortable with $5/hour plus deal bonuses.

8.     Provide DISC test results: 
/disc-personality-test/

9.     Copy of resume.



Small Detail Test

At the end of your application, write this exact sentence:

"I understand that this role requires calm consistency, accurate follow-up, and clean files."



Applications that do not follow the instructions above may not be reviewed. This role is for someone who pays close attention to details before the job even begins.

title: Heir Outreach Specialist
description:
We are hiring a confident, persuasive, and highly proactive Heir Outreach Specialist to help our real estate investment company contact property owners and heirs connected to distressed Florida properties. This is not a passive admin role. This role is for someone who enjoys starting conversations, moving people to action, asking direct questions, and staying calm when a family situation is complicated.



Our business solves title problems involving inherited property, probate issues, tax deed risk, liens, judgments, and family ownership problems. Your job is to help us reach the right heirs, confirm family relationships, gather key facts, build trust quickly, and keep communication moving so our acquisitions and transaction teams can close deals.



What You Will Do

• Call, text, and follow up with heirs and property owners connected to inherited or distressed Florida real estate.

• Start conversations confidently with people who may not be expecting your call.

• Identify decision-makers inside families with multiple heirs, siblings, children, spouses, or extended relatives.

• Ask clear fact-finding questions about family relationships, deceased owners, probate status, property history, occupancy, and seller motivation.

• Build rapport quickly while still keeping the conversation focused and productive.

• Overcome hesitation and confusion without being pushy, rude, or robotic.

• Document every conversation accurately inside our CRM so the rest of the team knows exactly what happened and what needs to happen next.

• Coordinate warm handoffs to the acquisitions team when a seller or heir is ready to discuss an offer.

• Persistently follow up until the family situation is understood, the right person is reached, or the lead is properly disqualified.



Who This Role Is Perfect For

• You are naturally confident on the phone and do not freeze when someone is guarded, confused, emotional, or skeptical.

• You like winning conversations, solving people puzzles, and figuring out who has authority inside a family.

• You are comfortable being direct, but you know how to sound respectful and human.

• You move fast, follow up aggressively, and do not need to be reminded five times to complete the next step.

• You prefer clear goals, measurable results, and real responsibility over repetitive low-impact admin work.

• You can handle messy information, incomplete family trees, and leads where the first person you reach is not the final decision-maker.

• You are energized by the challenge of turning cold or lukewarm contacts into productive conversations.



You Will Not Be a Fit If

• You are uncomfortable making outbound calls or speaking with strangers.

• You need every step scripted before you can take action.

• You avoid difficult conversations or give up after one unanswered call.

• You are careless with notes, names, dates, phone numbers, or relationship details.

• You sound overly timid, overly formal, or robotic on the phone.

• You prefer back-office data entry and do not want to be accountable for outreach results.



Required Skills

• Strong spoken English with a clear, confident, professional phone presence.

• Experience with outbound calling, sales, appointment setting, customer service, collections, real estate, legal intake, probate, or lead follow-up is strongly preferred.

• Ability to ask questions, listen carefully, and control the direction of a conversation.

• Comfortable using CRM systems, spreadsheets, Google Workspace, WhatsApp, and phone software.

• Fast and accurate note-taking after calls and text conversations.

• Stable internet connection, quiet work environment, and reliable computer.

• High ownership: you follow through without needing constant supervision.



Real Estate / Probate Experience

title: Supply Chain & Inventory Manager
description:
Type: Full time · Remote · Monday to Friday

Salary: $400 - $600 USD/month depending on experience.



How to apply — read this first



Do not send a message here. Do not send a CV here.



Go to this link and complete the application: 



Pick this role from the list. There is a field inside to upload your CV — that is where we want it. Applications sent any other way are ignored.



What the job is



We run several supplement brands on a subscription model. Our stock sits in three different fulfilment centres, our products are made in China, and our subscribers get charged on a fixed cycle whether or not we have inventory to ship them.



Right now nobody owns that chain. Orders get placed when someone remembers. Stock counts live in different places and do not always agree. We find out we are running low when support starts getting
s.



That is this job. You own inventory from the factory to the customer's door. If we run out of stock, that is on you. If we sit on six months of dead inventory, that is also on you.



Your work



1. Know exactly what we have, everywhere. One stock sheet, updated daily, covering all three fulfilment centres and every SKU. Units on hand, units in transit, units reserved. When the number in the sheet does not match what the warehouse says, you find out why and you fix it.



2. Never let us go out of stock. Work out how fast each SKU sells, how long production and shipping actually take, and set a reorder point for every product. Then place the orders before we hit it. On a subscription business a stockout does not just cost one sale, it cancels a recurring customer.



3. Run the suppliers. Place purchase orders, chase production, confirm quantities and quality before anything ships, track every shipment, and escalate when a date slips. Push on pricing as our volume grows.



4. Run the fulfilment centres. Monitor how fast they ship, catch mis-shipments and damaged deliveries, reconcile their stock reports against ours, and hold them to their numbers.



5. Watch the shipments. Parcels stuck in transit, batches never scanned, customs problems. You spot these before customers complain, and you tell support what to say when they do.



6. Report weekly. Stock position, incoming shipments and dates, cash tied up in inventory, anything at risk in the next 30 days. Short, in numbers.



What we need from you



You have done inventory or supply chain for an e-commerce brand, not just warehouse admin. You have placed real purchase orders with real money behind them.



You are comfortable with numbers. Reorder points, lead times, sell-through rates, units per day. You can build this in a spreadsheet without being walked through it.



You are precise. This job is counting things correctly and noticing when two numbers disagree. There is no room for approximation here.



You chase people. Suppliers go quiet, warehouses do not reply. You follow up until you have an answer, without being asked twice.



Written English good enough to deal with Chinese suppliers and US fulfilment centres by
.



Nice to have



Experience with China sourcing and freight. Supplements, food or anything with expiry dates and batch numbers. Shopify. Experience on a subscription business, where demand is predictable and a stockout is unforgivable.



Before you apply



Some of our brands are in health and women's wellness, including intimacy products. The work is never explicit, but if that topic is not for you, this role is not for you and that is completely fine.



What we offer



A stable, long-term, full-time position.

Real ownership. You d
 what we order and when. No committee.

Direct work with the owner. No middle manager.

Paid on time, every time.



Again: the only way to apply is

We run outbound LinkedIn campaigns for a book of clients. This role owns the daily engine behind them: checking the infrastructure is healthy every morning, working the client inboxes, booking meetings, and logging the numbers so nothing gets lost.



We're looking for someone who:

• Has excellent written English — you'll be replying to prospects in our clients' names

• Can work US hours (6h/day, same start time every day)

• Has experience managing an outbound inbox — replying to leads, handling objections, booking calls

• Is comfortable in Google Sheets (trackers, dropdowns, reading a % column and knowing what it's telling you)

• Is precise and honest with a checklist — we'd rather see an unticked box than a ticked one you didn't actually verify

• Escalates clearly in Slack: what broke, who it affects, what it costs, what you already tried, what you need

• Follows SOPs exactly and hits daily targets without being chased



Your role will include:

• A morning infrastructure check across every live client — accounts connected, licences valid, campaigns actually sending, enough leads in the pipe, scrapers healthy

• Logging yesterday's numbers (sends, replies, positives, warm intros, bookings) and posting the daily report

• Clearing the overnight inbox backlog by value — booking confirmations first, then meeting requests, then questions

• Replying to leads throughout the day using our templates, adapted to each thread

• Sending booking confirmations and reminders same-day, every time — date, time, time zone, duration, joining link

• Running follow-up cadences and keeping lead statuses and tags current

• A midday pacing check, and a 20-minute end-of-day close-out that leaves the inbox at zero

• Escalating anything outside template scope (pricing, legal, complaints) instead of guessing



You'll be trained on our written SOP and daily workflow — it's step by step, and it tells you exactly what to do when a check fails. We're not asking you to invent a system. We're asking you to run ours reliably, every single day.



This starts with a 2-week trial at $5/hour. If you perform well, we'll raise the rate and move to a long-term arrangement.

title: Inside Sales Closer — US Career Training Enrollments (Phone-Based)
description:
About Us:

Access Computer Training is a Florida-based, CIE-licensed technical training school with 12+ years in operation and 700+ graduates who have launched careers in IT, Cybersecurity, Cloud, Office Admin, and Project Management. Most of our students train through workforce grant funding, Vocational Rehabilitation, or VA benefits — so they don't pay out of pocket. Students who don't qualify for funding can self-pay in full or finance their training through Fortify, so there's a path for nearly every applicant we talk to. 



Job Summary: 

We're hiring a closer, not a coordinator. You'll be on the phone with US-based leads who've already raised their hand for career training — your job is to qualify them fast, walk them through their funding options, handle objections, and get the enrollment agreement signed. This is a sales role with a script foundation, not a scripted read-and-recite job — we need someone who can hear resistance and work it, not just push through a call flow. 





What you'll actually do: 



- Outbound and inbound calls to warm leads (not cold prospecting — these people already inquired) 



- Qualify leads against 4 funding paths in the first 5 minutes of a call 



- Run consultation calls and close on a signed enrollment agreement 



- Handle real objections — cost, timing, "I need to think about it," "I already talked to someone else" — without going off-script into guesses 



- Log every call and follow-up in our CRM (GoHighLevel) same-day, no exceptions 





You're a strong fit if: 



- You have real phone-sales closing experience — outbound sales, telemarketing, insurance sales (not claims/service), timeshare, solar, BPO sales campaigns, or similar 



- You're comfortable being told "no" multiple times a day and staying warm anyway 



- Your spoken English is clear and confident on a live call, not just written English 



- You've worked with a CRM before and you update it without being chased 



- You can commit to a graveyard shift — this is a US Eastern-time role 





This is not a fit if: 



- Your background is customer service, data entry, chat support, or general VA work with no sales/closing component 



- You've done appointment-setting but have never actually closed the deal yourself 



- You're looking for a quiet admin role — this is a talk-to-strangers-on-the-phone-all-day role 





To apply — this step is required, not optional: 

- Send a 60-second voice recording (phone memo is fine) responding to this exact objection, as if you were on a live call: "I already talked to another school and I'm not sure yours is any different." 

We're listening for how you actually sound on a call, not for a perfect script. 

Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed. 



Compensation: 

$7.00 USD/hour base + performance bonus per enrollment, paid once your enrolled student reaches 40% course completion: 



Enrollments 1–5 each month: $25 flat, each 



Enrollments 6–9 each month: 2% of base tuition, each (programs range $5,000–$7,500, so roughly $100–$150 per enrollment at this tier) 



Enrollments 10+ each month: 5% of base tuition, each (roughly $250–$375 per enrollment at this tier) 



*Bonus tier is locked in once you reach it that month — it doesn't drop if a student later withdraws for reasons outside your control 



*Enrollment count resets every calendar month 



*Hours: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST (this is a 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippines time shift

title: Operations & Systems Coordinator (Notion) - UK Hours, Part-Time to Full-Time
description:
KSTN Digital is a UK marketing-technology consultancy. We build patient acquisition systems for dental clinics - websites, CRMs, chatbots, automations, content and ads - plus selected e-commerce work. Small team (founder plus three), fast-moving and systems-heavy: Notion, Airtable, Slack, Shopify, Klaviyo, Google Workspace, Xero.



THE ROLE



We need a systems and operations thinker. Someone who learns how a business actually runs, spots what's held together with tape, and rebuilds it properly. This starts part-time and grows into a full-time role - our last hire joined the same way and is now full-time.



Four things matter most.



1. Notion. Our operations hub lives in Notion - tasks, projects, clients, meetings. You keep it true every day, and you are expected to propose how it should be structured, not just tidy it. If you have built a Notion system for a team, we want to see it.



2. Client coordination. Our clients are UK dental clinics and an e-commerce brand. You run their content approvals end to end (load, notify, chase decisions, log feedback, brief our designer), get client staff set up and actually using our systems, sort access and logins, and follow up until things are done. You speak to clients directly, in writing and on the phone, with the founder in the loop.



3. Admin that keeps money moving. Invoice schedule and drafting in Xero, payment chasing, supplier and adviser follow-ups, access and account admin, password manager.



4. Improving the machine. Processes get documented, gaps get closed, and things that keep going wrong get fixed at the root rather than chased every week. You will have a Claude seat and we expect you to use AI to move faster - you do not need to be a developer, just curious and honest about what it gets wrong.



As the role grows: weekly CRM hygiene checks in Airtable, client reporting, outbound work (lead lists,
 sequences, reply triage, demo booking), warm patient calls, and support across the founder's other ventures. Authority grows with trust, and we write the progression down.



HOURS



Part-time to start: 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday, in a fixed window inside UK business hours - normally 12pm to 4pm UK (7pm to 11pm Manila). Full-time is 9am to 5pm UK. The UK-hours requirement is not negotiable; you will be talking to UK clients.



PAY AND PROGRESSION



$500 per month part-time, rising to $1,500 per month on moving to full-time. We review at 4 weeks, and the move to full-time can happen as early as month one or two if you are hitting the benchmarks - they are written down and shared with you on day one, so you always know where you stand. 13th month pay, pro-rated while part-time. Performance bonus tied to agreed outcomes. Training budget for Notion and Airtable certification. We hire on capability and trajectory, not years - early-career candidates are welcome if you can show us the work.



MUST HAVE



Excellent written English. Demonstrable Notion skill - a workspace you built, screenshots or a portfolio link. Comfortable on the phone with a clear, friendly manner. Reliable internet with a backup connection and backup power. ID Proof 80+, Timeproof, camera on for interviews. Able to commit to the fixed UK window now, and to full-time later.



NICE TO HAVE



Airtable, Xero, Slack, Google Workspace admin, Shopify, Klaviyo. Dental, healthcare or agency experience.



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip this are not read)



1. Start your message with the word LATTICE.

2. Attach or link evidence of a Notion workspace you built. Screenshots are fine.

3. Answer in 3 to 5 sentences: a client says on WhatsApp that a video needs fixes, but the task in Notion shows it approved. What do you do, in order?

4. Tell us about a process or system you built or fixed that people still use today - what was broken, and what did you change?

5. Write the exact message you would send to a clinic manager who has twice ignored our request for their Instagram login, and our designer cannot post without it. Just the message - no explanation.



Shortlisted candidates do a 15-minute video call, then a paid 2 to 3 day trial on realistic tasks.

Administrative support: Handling sales-related paperwork, managing contracts and agreements, and coordinating with the service desk, projects and accounts teams.



Client onboarding: Helping new clients transition smoothly by coordinating service setup, orders and introductions to the technical team.



SKILLS WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Strong communication skills: Clear, professional written and spoken English, with the ability to build rapport with clients, suppliers and colleagues and explain technical concepts in plain language.



Technical knowledge: A working understanding of IT services such as Microsoft 365, networking, cybersecurity, cloud and backup, so you can discuss client needs and order the right products.



PSA/CRM proficiency: Confident day-to-day use of HaloPSA to manage the pipeline, orders, client data and activity.



Financial accuracy: Comfortable working in Xero and with purchase orders, supplier invoices and margins, with a keen eye for detail.



Data analysis skills: Able to interpret sales and order data and produce reports that inform decisions.



Organisational skills: Able to juggle multiple orders, quotes and deadlines in a fast-moving environment without dropping the ball.



WHAT WE OFFER

- PHP 60,000 – 70,000 per month, depending on experience.

- Paid in PHP twice a month, with payslips and your contract available any time through the Pear Tree employee hub.

- 13th month pay.

- A stable, full-time remote role with an established Australian MSP, working alongside our existing Philippines-based team.

- Modern tooling (HaloPSA, Xero, Microsoft 365) and clear processes.

Please submit your CV along with a 2-minute video introducing yourself, your MSP background and your experience with HaloPSA, sales ordering, purchase orders and Xero. Applications without a video will not be considered.

title: Client Relationship & Operations Manager

# Client Relationship & Operations Manager



**Full-Time Remote Position (Philippines)**



Established U.S.-based home service company seeking a highly organized, proactive, and professional **Client Relationship & Operations Manager** to become a long-term part of a fast-growing operation.



This is **NOT an entry-level virtual assistant role**.



We are looking for someone capable of handling real operational responsibility, customer communication, scheduling coordination, follow-ups, organization, and administrative oversight in a fast-paced environment.



If you require constant supervision, struggle with communication, or are uncomfortable taking initiative and ownership, this role will not be a good fit.



We are looking for someone dependable, detail-oriented, highly responsive, and capable of helping maintain structure and organization across multiple moving parts of the business.



## Work Schedule



* Monday through Friday

* 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

* 1-hour lunch break

* 40 hours per week



Applicants **MUST** be fully available during U.S. Eastern business hours.



This is a real-time operational role, not passive task work.



You are expected to remain online, responsive, and immediately available during working hours for:



* Phone calls

* Customer communication

* Scheduling updates

* Internal team coordination

* Operational support

* Video calls when needed



## Communication Requirements



Applicants must be comfortable being on camera and participating in live video calls during work hours.



There will be situations where management or field staff may initiate video calls to:



* Discuss live field situations

* Review projects in real time

* Coordinate customer concerns

* Assist with active jobsite situations

* Communicate face-to-face regarding operational matters



Professional appearance, strong communication skills, and comfort on camera are required.



## Compensation



Starting compensation is **$5 to $7 USD per hour**, depending on experience, qualifications, communication skills, and interview performance.



In addition to hourly pay, this position includes a **generous performance-based incentive program** connected to specific operational and performance benchmarks.



Performance incentives are tracked and calculated **weekly**, giving strong performers the opportunity to increase their income quickly.



A successful Brand Manager who consistently meets or exceeds performance expectations should be capable of earning an effective income of **$10+ per hour** through a combination of hourly pay and incentives.



Additional compensation growth is available as performance, responsibility, and the company continue to grow.



We are looking for a long-term team member, not a temporary freelancer.



## Core Responsibilities



### Client Relationship Management



* Answer inbound phone calls professionally

* Respond to customer texts and
s quickly

* Maintain strong customer communication and follow-up

* Assist with scheduling and appointment confirmations

* Follow up with leads, estimates, and existing customers

* Handle customer questions and concerns professionally

* Help maintain an excellent customer experience

* Ensure customers do not get forgotten or lost during the sales and service process



### Operations Coordination



* Coordinate calendars, schedules, and field operations

* Organize and track ongoing tasks and follow-ups

* Maintain accurate CRM notes and customer records

* Monitor pending estimates, appointments, and customer opportunities

* Ensure important operational details do not fall through the cracks

* Coordinate internally with management, office staff, and field crews

* Help improve workflows and organization throughout the company

* Identify problems and help find solutions before they become larger issues



### Administrative & Management Support



* Assist management with organization and operational oversight

* Track pending items, priorities, and project updates

* Maintain structure, accountability, and communication

* Help management stay organized in a fast-paced environment

* Take ownership of assigned responsibilities without requiring constant supervision



### Sales Follow-Up & Customer Retention



* Consistently follow up with leads and open estimates

* Help move potential customers through the decision-making process

* Reconnect with customers who have not responded

* Follow up after completed projects

* Assist with review requests and customer retention

* Identify opportunities for repeat business and additional services



This is not an aggressive sales position, but strong follow-up and communication are a major part of the role.



### Social Media & Marketing Coordination



* Organize project photos and videos

* Assist with social media scheduling and posting

* Coordinate customer review requests

* Respond to messages and engagement when needed

* Help maintain brand consistency and online presence



## Required Qualifications



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Clear and confident phone communication

* Strong organizational skills

* High attention to detail

* Fast response time

* Strong customer service skills

* Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

* Comfortable participating in live video calls

* Professional appearance and communication

* Ability to think critically and solve problems independently

* Ability to prioritize responsibilities without constant direction

* Strong follow-up habits

* Reliable internet connection

* Quiet and professional work environment

* Ability to take ownership and accept accountability



## Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is strongly preferred:



* Operations coordination

* Scheduling and dispatching

* CRM management

* Customer service

* Lead follow-up or sales support

* Social media management

* Executive or administrative support

* Workflow and systems management

* Home service or construction industry



Previous experience working directly with U.S.-based customers is a major plus.



## Who This Position Is For



We are building a serious operation and looking for serious professionals.



This position is best suited for someone who enjoys:



* Organization

* Customer communication

* Follow-up

* Problem-solving

* Operational structure

* Improving systems

* Taking responsibility

* Helping businesses grow



This is **NOT a passive assistant role**.



We are looking for someone who can become a trusted operational asset, take ownership of their responsibilities, and become a long-term part of the company.



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your resume

2. A short introduction explaining your relevant experience

3. A **1–2 minute video introduction** so we can see and hear how you communicate

4. A brief description of your experience with CRM systems, scheduling, customer communication, and follow-up

5. An example of a system, workflow, or process you helped improve in a previous position



In your application subject line, include the phrase:



**“Structure Creates Growth”**



**Please include a 1–2 minute video explaining why your previous experience, skills, and work style would help contribute to the growth of our business.**



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.

• Think strategically about how we can improve our sales process

• Test new ideas for generating and converting customers

• Identify opportunities to increase recurring revenue



This is not primarily a cold-calling position.



However, you should be comfortable picking up the phone, following up persistently, and helping close opportunities when necessary.



We don’t want someone who simply checks off “followed up with lead.”



We want someone who thinks:



“How do we turn this person into a customer?”



RECRUITING & TEAM GROWTH



Finding great cleaners is one of the most important parts of growing our company.



You will help us continuously improve our recruiting process.



This may include:



• Posting cleaning opportunities on job boards and other platforms

• Finding new sources for cleaner candidates

• Reviewing applications

• Communicating with candidates

• Conducting initial screening calls

• Scheduling interviews

• Following up with promising candidates

• Keeping our recruiting pipeline organized

• Helping onboard new cleaners

• Maintaining relationships with strong candidates

• Thinking strategically about how we can attract better cleaners



We don’t want recruiting to only happen when we’re desperate for another cleaner.



Part of your responsibility will be helping us maintain a strong pipeline of potential cleaners as the company grows.



OPERATIONS & SCHEDULING SUPPORT



We already have a team member who manages much of our daily scheduling and customer communication.



However, everyone on our team should be willing and able to step in when something needs to get done.



You may occasionally help with:



• Scheduling cleaning appointments

• Confirming appointments with customers

• Confirming jobs with cleaners

• Responding to customer texts

• Answering phone calls

• Adjusting schedules

• Handling last-minute changes

• Making sure cleaners have the correct job information

• Helping resolve customer or cleaner issues

• Covering operational responsibilities when another team member is unavailable



You should be comfortable jumping into the day-to-day business when necessary.



SYSTEMS & PROCESS IMPROVEMENT



We are constantly trying to make the company better.



We want you to notice problems and help solve them.



For example:



• If leads aren’t being followed up with properly, tell us.

• If our recruiting process is producing poor candidates, help us improve it.

• If customers keep asking the same question, suggest a better process.

• If something in our CRM is disorganized, organize it.

• If we’re doing something manually that could be automated, bring it up.

• If you think there’s an opportunity we’re missing, tell us.



You will be encouraged to think critically about how the business operates rather than simply following instructions.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who is:



• Extremely reliable

• Proactive and resourceful

• Highly organized

• Detail-oriented

• A strong written and verbal communicator

• Comfortable speaking with U.S.-based customers

• Comfortable working U.S. business hours

• Persistent with follow-up

• Able to solve problems independently

• Comfortable taking ownership of projects

• Comfortable learning new software and systems

• Able to follow systems, procedures, and training manuals

• Willing to make suggestions and challenge inefficient processes

• Interested in understanding how the entire business works

• Motivated by helping a company grow



Most importantly, we want someone with initiative.



If you finish your assigned work and notice 15 leads haven’t been followed up with, we want you to follow up with them.



If our recruiting pipeline is weak, we want you thinking about where else we can find candidates.



If you notice something disorganized, we want you helping organize it.



If there’s an opportunity to generate more revenue, we want you bringing it to our attention.



We don’t want someone who needs to constantly ask:



“What should I do next?”



COMMUNICATION SKILLS



Excellent spoken and written English is required.



You should be comfortable:



• Speaking naturally with U.S.-based customers

• Answering phone calls

• Calling potential customers

• Texting customers professionally

• Writing
s

• Speaking with cleaner candidates

• Handling objections

• Handling frustrated customers

• Communicating clearly with the rest of our team



You should be able to communicate naturally without sounding like you’re simply reading from a script.



U.S. WORKING HOURS & AVAILABILITY



You must be comfortable working U.S. business hours in Pacific Time (California) and maintaining a consistent schedule during those hours.



Because you will communicate with customers, leads, cleaner candidates, and our internal team, you need to be available while our business is operating.



We are looking for someone who:



• Is genuinely comfortable working U.S. hours long-term

• Can consistently maintain the agreed-upon schedule

• Is responsive throughout working hours

• Is comfortable making and receiving calls during U.S. business hours

• Does not regularly have other jobs or commitments that interfere with this schedule

• Communicates in advance if something affects their availability



Please do not apply if you are only temporarily willing to work U.S. Pacific Time hours.



Reliability and consistent availability are extremely important for this position.



EXPERIENCE WE LIKE



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



• Cleaning companies

• BookingKoala

• GoHighLevel (GHL)

• Operations

• Virtual assistant work

• Customer service

• Recruiting

• Sales

• Lead follow-up

• Appointment setting

• Home services

• Property management

• CRM management

• Scheduling

• Working with U.S.-based companies



You do not need experience with everything listed above.



We care much more about your intelligence, communication, reliability, initiative, organization, and ability to learn quickly.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



After getting fully trained, we want this person to become someone we can trust with important parts of the company.



You should eventually be able to look across our:



Leads → Customers → Cleaners → Schedule → Recruiting Pipeline



…and identify what needs attention without constantly being told.



Success means:



• Leads are consistently followed up with

• Quotes don’t get forgotten

• Potential customers aren’t falling through the cracks

• Our CRM stays organized

• Our recruiting pipeline is continuously moving

• Strong cleaner candidates are identified

• Operational issues are handled quickly

• Customers receive professional communication

• New growth opportunities are identified

• Systems and processes continuously improve

• The owner has fewer things requiring direct involvement



We want you to become someone who understands how the business works and can be trusted to take ownership and get things done.



COMPENSATION



This is a full-time position.



Base Pay: $600/month



Additional compensation will include:



• Sales commissions

• Performance bonuses

• Opportunities for increased compensation as your responsibilities grow



High performers will have significant opportunities to grow with the company.



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for someone who wants to stay with us long-term.



As the company grows, there will be opportunities to take ownership of larger parts of the business and move into a more senior operations or management role.



If you demonstrate that you can consistently solve problems, improve the business, and take ownership without needing constant supervision, we will give you more responsibility.



We’re looking for someone who wants to understand how a business works, take ownership, solve problems, and become an increasingly important part of the company.

title: Global Logistics Specialist
description:
About Us:

Rhino USA is a leading global e-commerce company specializing in Powersport Accessories for towing, hauling, over-landing, and all outdoor adventures. We are dedicated to providing our customers with high-quality products through efficient supply chain management, strategic planning, and premium customer experience. As we continue to expand our operations worldwide, we are seeking a skilled Global Logistics Specialist to join our team.



Overview

RhinoUSA is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Global Logistics Specialist to manage and optimize the flow of products from manufacturers to destinations around the globe. This critical role ensures seamless coordination, tracking, and receiving of containers while maintaining accurate landed costs and ownership of all importing/exporting processes.

The ideal candidate will be highly organized, a subject matter expert in global logistics, and passionate about ensuring supply chain excellence. With key performance indicators (KPIs) including container utilization, delivery lead times, and shipping costs, this role is essential to our global operations. As the Point of Contact for global logistics it will be important that responsiveness, professionalism, and accuracy are top skill sets for this role.



Job Duties and Responsibilities



Container Booking, Tracking, and Coordination

-Track, coordinate, and monitor all containers from manufacturer to destination, ensuring timely and efficient delivery.

-Book containers, manage shipping schedules, and oversee the entire transit process for global shipments.

-Ensure delivery lead times from port to 3PL meet established targets and resolve delays or issues proactively.

-Book containers for shipment to selling country within SLA from GRD.



Importing/Exporting Expertise

-Own and manage the entire importing/exporting process, including customs documentation, compliance, and regulatory requirements.

-Act as the subject matter expert on global logistics, advising on best practices and process improvements.



Reporting and Analysis

-Build and maintain dashboards to track key metrics, including container utilization rates, delivery lead times, and shipping costs per pound.

-Identify trends and propose solutions to optimize global logistics performance.

-Maintain relationships with key logistics partners to ensure lowest cost, highest quality service.

-Report weekly on containers in transit and any delays that might be relevant.



Qualifications:

-Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or related field.

-8-10 years of experience in global logistics, import/export, or supply chain operations.

-Proficiency in demand planning software and tools, with experience in Shopify, Inventory Planning Systems, ERP systems (
), and 
 preferred.

-Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed decisions

-Proficient use of Excel for data analysis

-Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across different teams and cultures.

-Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and precision in supply chain management.

-Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities and deadlines.

-Understanding of global supply chain dynamics and familiarity with import/export regulations

-Passion or interest in powersports and/or outdoor supply industry

-Entrepreneurial spirit a plus





Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

-Container Utilization: Achieve and maintain a 95% container utilization rate.

-Delivery Lead Times: Ensure delivery lead times from GRD to Booking, and port to 3PL remain within established benchmarks. --Improve delivery lead times by improving process and timeliness of response and resolution.

-Shipping Costs: Optimize and track shipping costs per pound, reducing expenses without sacrificing service quality.
